title: DGM – Projects
description:
Job Title :- General Manager – Projects

**Industry:** Solar EPC / Renewable Energy

**Preferred Experience:** Utility-scale solar EPC projects, including 50 MW+ projects

**Location:** Kolkata

The **DGM – Projects** will be responsible for providing overall leadership and strategic direction for the company's solar EPC project execution function.

The key objectives of the DGM – Projects will include:

· Ensure timely completion and commissioning of solar EPC projects within approved budgets and contractual commitments.

· Establish and maintain strong project execution and governance systems.

· Drive **project planning, monitoring** and performance improvement across the project portfolio.

· Ensure effective utilization of manpower, equipment, **supply chain planning**.

· Improve project productivity, execution efficiency and overall **project profitability**.

· Ensure timely billing, certification, commercial closure and project handover.

· Develop and mentor a strong project management and execution team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Project Portfolio & Execution Leadership

Project Planning & Scheduling

Construction & Site Execution

Resource & Organizational Management

Commercial, Cost & Contract Management

Contractor & Vendor Management

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your current Designation and what industry you are working - Solar EPC / Renewable Energy
* Do you have the knowledge of Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Project Work (HT, LT) and also basic knowledge/experience of T&D related to project evacuation
* What is your current and expected CTC? What is your notice period
* Are you working at Kolkata

title: Project Control Services Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Project Control Services Practitioner  
**Project Role Description :** Develop and execute end-to-end project management activities of an assigned program, project, or contracted service within a globally sourced delivery model.
  
**Must have skills :** Project Resource Management  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As a Project Control Services Practitioner, a typical day involves managing comprehensive project activities from initiation through completion within a globally distributed delivery framework. This role requires coordinating various aspects of the assigned program or project, ensuring alignment with overall objectives, and maintaining seamless communication across diverse teams. The practitioner actively monitors progress, addresses challenges, and supports the smooth execution of project tasks to meet deadlines and deliverables, fostering collaboration and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project milestones are achieved effectively.
* Maintain accurate documentation and reporting to support project transparency and decision-making.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and sharing knowledge to enhance overall team performance.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Project Resource Management.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple project resources and schedules efficiently.
* Ability to analyze project data and resource allocation to optimize productivity.
* Excellent communication skills to facilitate coordination among global teams.
* Familiarity with project management tools and software to track progress and resource utilization.

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Project Resource Management.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  
15 years full time education

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Description: Project Manager – IT & Technology**

**Company:** Centreax Technologies  
**Location:** Salt Lake, Sector V, Kolkata  
**Experience:** 12–15 Years  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

Centreax Technologies is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead end-to-end technology projects, manage cross-functional teams, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge across multiple technologies, excellent client-handling (both Domestic and International) and English communication skills, and the ability to coordinate development, testing, and deployment activities while ensuring project objectives are met.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete project lifecycle, including planning, estimation, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure.
* Coordinate development, testing, and technical teams to ensure timely delivery and quality standards.
* Manage client communication, stakeholder expectations, project reviews, and escalations.
* Use Jira to track project progress, tasks, milestones, risks, and deliverables.
* Work closely with technical leads and architects to address technical challenges and integration requirements.
* Prepare project plans, status reports, technical documentation, and management updates.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and overall delivery performance.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions to ensure successful delivery.
* Follow Agile/Scrum practices and drive continuous improvement in project execution.

**Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12–15 years of professional experience in IT project management, software development, or technology delivery.
* Must hold a valid PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum project management certification.
* Strong knowledge of multiple technologies, software development methodologies, application architecture, APIs, and system integration.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions, with the ability to coordinate AI-driven projects and collaborate with technical teams on AI-based application development and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and practical knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience coordinating software development, QA/testing, defect management, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Strong understanding of project planning, estimation, budgeting, resource management, risk mitigation, and delivery governance.
* Excellent English communication, leadership, domestic and international client-handling, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare and review project plans, requirement documents, technical specifications, and status reports.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, handle multiple priorities, and deliver projects within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Candidates with strong technical architecture knowledge, excellent client-handling skills, and proven experience in managing software development and testing teams will be preferred.**

Pay: Up to ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
